name: LegalCore
description: Recognizing events and their coreferential mentions in a document is essential for understanding semantic meanings of text. The existing research on event coreference resolution is mostly limited to news articles. In this paper, we present the first dataset for the legal domain, LegalCore, which has been annotated with comprehensive event and event coreference information. The legal contract documents we annotated in this dataset are several times longer than news articles, with an average length of around 25k tokens per document. The annotations show that legal documents have dense event mentions and feature both short-distance and super long-distance coreference links between event mentions. reputation: A new legal-domain benchmark that extends event coreference evaluation beyond newswire and is mainly known from its recent arXiv release.
notes: Long legal documents (~25k tokens on average) with dense mentions and long-distance coreference make this substantially harder than standard event coreference datasets.
